provenBoundary: First declared child did not reach READY. No eleven-assertion hosted acceptance receipt was established. Isolation infrastructure started, but complete identity separation and journal guarantees were not accepted.
diagnosticDefect: hosted test installs c.on(fault,()=>{}); controller catches enrollment errors, kills cohort, and emits fault. ready() reports only child stderr, which contains SQLite warning. The originating controller error and child exit signal/code are absent from retained log.

leadingStaticHypothesis.cause: Operator reads /proc/<distinct-UID child>/ns/pid in processIdentity but Docker operator capability allowlist omits SYS_PTRACE. Cross-principal proc namespace inspection is subject to ptrace access checks; DAC_OVERRIDE alone does not establish that authority. The resulting error would match swallowed-fault/rapid-kill path.
leadingStaticHypothesis.mustNotClaim: Do not assert the exact failing syscall or errno was observed.

minimumCorrection.mandatory: Retain a bounded, secret-free controller fault code/message/stack plus child exit code/signal in failure evidence and propagate the original fault to the failing test. Preserve all identity, permissions, readiness and no-skip assertions.
minimumCorrection.capabilityDecision: If retaining direct cross-principal /proc identity inspection, explicitly authorize only the isolated operator SYS_PTRACE capability, never runtime capabilities; verify runtime CapEff remains zero and no host PID namespace or production mount exists. Alternatively use an independently reviewed equivalent identity-observation mechanism, without weakening identity proof.
minimumCorrection.scope: Only targeted harness/identity-observation boundary; no broad journal rewrite and no deadline increase.
minimumCorrection.execution: Any changed tree needs fresh review and owner exact-tree approval before one new automatic targeted run. No rerun of failed approved source.

preserved: All prior accepted scopes and six local journal checks remain preserved. Production writer graph, cutover, full restoration and protected custody remain separately unproved.
